description: The failure mode exact-quote grounding exists for: a model that quotes its source almost correctly. One claim quotes the page verbatim; the other tidies 'AUD 30' into 'AUD 30.00' and reformats the closing day. Both look like provenance. Only one is.

corpus.title: Visit Melbourne Gardens
corpus.text: Melbourne Gardens is open every day of the year from 7.30am until sunset. Entry to the gardens is free. The Aboriginal Heritage Walk runs on Thursdays and Sundays and costs AUD 30 per adult, and bookings are required at least one day ahead. The Visitor Centre is closed on Christmas Day.
